scope: Explicit, previously native-G2-ported cross-region C source donor links; non-exhaustive; NOT a one-to-one semantic correspondence table or a new matching-C promotion.
relationship_rules: Links are directional source donor evidence; read either endpoint to locate the other region's corresponding donor.
Multiple USA or Japan code locations may share one donor. Do not impose a one-to-one function identity.
Identical original instruction bytes and prior matching-C ports do not establish functional semantic equivalence or exact matching in a different new translation unit.
Unlisted pairs have unknown relationship; no fixed arithmetic translation of ROM offsets, VMA or overlay code addresses.
Canonical accepted C and full original-ROM proof remain governed by the region manifests and inventories.

known_same_label_non_equivalence.reason: Original ROM bodies differ across regions; USA initialises a fixed global pointer and Japan reads/reset-clears a system table. Do not reuse based on name alone.
